question: Should scoped agent run tokens be allowed to read raw WorkItem intents? The investigate scope can already read them over REST, but only for the run's own WorkItem (its BindWorkItem route ^/api/v1/work-items/([^/]+)(/.*)?$ covers /intents). So option 2 only works if it also closes that REST route, not just the MCP tool.

Closing the REST /intents routes for scoped runs also blocks the investigator's own context assembly: cwft-mctl-agents-investigate.yaml sets WORK_ITEM_INTENT_SOURCE=on with MCTL_RUN_TOKEN_MODE=enforce, so the pod reads GET /api/v1/work-items/{id}/intents with the scoped run token, and a referenced intent it cannot read fails the run (intent-unresolved). How should that consumer be handled?
